name: How much does a garage renovation typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a garage renovation typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a garage renovation varies significantly based on the scope of work, materials chosen, and necessary structural or utility modifications. A basic conversion might start from $20,000 to $40,000, while a full ADU conversion with new plumbing and electrical could range from $80,000 to $150,000 or more. A detailed estimate requires an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for garage renovations vary widely, from $20,000 for basic updates to over $150,000 for full ADU conversions.
